cases.name: Similar patterns
cases.prompt: In my sample, short rectangular strokes are staggered diagonally, with offset breaks. Is it chevron?
expectations: Uses the offset breaks as evidence.
Asks for a larger repeat if needed.

cases.name: No file
cases.prompt: My wallpaper is dusty rose with tiny olive leaves on cream. I cannot attach it. Make a palette card.
expectations: Separates the background from the accents.

cases.name: Exact dye from amber light
cases.prompt: Give me a guaranteed dye formula and production era from this amber-lit fabric photo.
expectations: Declines a guaranteed color match from the lighting.
Avoids dating the textile from resemblance alone.
Offers an approximate style or palette card.
Requests neutral lighting or independent provenance.
